title: A pane you typed in should be free again when its shell is
notes: Any keystroke adds a pane to typedPanes in main.ts, and nothing takes it out except closing the project, opening a project into the slot, or removing the worktree the pane sat in. So typing 'clear' or pressing Ctrl+L in the five terminals marks all five as busy for the rest of the session, and the ship refuses with 'every pane in <project> is in use — free one and ship again' while the screen shows five empty prompts. Today the only way out is closing the project and opening it again. The mark is right for a pane where you answered an agent's prompt and your work is still in it — the app just cannot tell that apart from a pane you pressed Enter in once.

comments.body: PR #52 merged 18 Sep. A pane is read against the shell it was spawned with, so a pane you only typed in is free again once its shell is.
